programme.title: Ip Man
programme.desc: Behind every great martial artist lies a teacher. Ip Man, starring Donnie Yen, is the award-winning film adaptation about the life story of Ip Man, grandmaster of Wing Chun and mentor to legendary kung fu superstar Bruce Lee. Set in Fo Shan, China during the Sino-Japanese War, Ip Man vividly brings to life the brutality of the infamous Japanese occupation, where once proud men are forced to fight to the death for a precious bag of rice. Defined by courage and humility, Ip Man, whose fighting skills are revered all over China, rises to the fore front. Upon refusing to teach his martial arts to the invading Japanese soldiers, he is forced to fight for the honor of his country in a series of battles that will culminate in a kill-or-be-killed showdown with Japan’s greatest fighter.

programme.title: Ip Man 2: Legend of the Grandmaster
programme.desc: International superstar Donnie Yen reprises his iconic role as the real-life kung fu grandmaster Ip Man, widely created as the man who brought Wing Chun kung fu to the world with the help of his star pupil- Bruce Lee. Master Ip, a new arrival in British-occupied Hong Kong, wants to open a martial arts academy to teach his unique Wing Chun style. A corrupt cabal of martial arts masters, led by Master Hung (Sammo Hung) refuses to allow him to teach in peace until he proves himself in a series of fights against the local master, which Ip does, in style. But even after earning the respect of the local masters, Ip’s troubles are far from over. Hong Kong under British rule is a new world of corruption and conflict between the Chinese locals and the British expats that run the city. When a Western-style boxer named “Twister” (Darren Shahlavi) comes to town to entertain the Brits, he insults Chinese martial arts in a horrifically violent way, and Ip is forced by honor to enter a brutal “King of the Ring” boxing match against Twister- and it’s East versus West in an amazing, knock-down drag-out fight to the finish.

Angie no se tranquiliza aún, y llama a un detective para vigilar la situación de cerca. Agustín aprovecha la escena para causarle culpa a Magdalena, mientras él la sigue engañando con Sofía. Luego, Magdalena va a una fiesta, donde tomas algunas fotos, y se encuentra con Ricardo, a quien le da una cachetada por haber escrito ese artículo sobre ella en la revista. Magdalena sale beneficiada por esto, ya que un hombre la felicita y le ofrece un trabajo en el interior del país.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Agustín confronta a Gabriel en la calle para dejarle claro que no se vuelva a meter con su mujer. Magdalena descubre en el baño de la casa de Sofía perfume y otras cosas de hombre, por lo que a ella no le queda más remedio que confesar que tiene novio. Magdalena se extraña, ya que siendo su amiga no le contó antes, y Sofía dice que no le contó antes porque el hombre es casado. Luego, Magdalena le cuenta esto a Agustín, y cuando Agustín se encuentra con Sofía se enoja con ella por no poder haber inventado otra excusa. A Gabriel le ofrecen ir a hacer un discurso a Caja Seca, un pueblo cercano, para, entre otras cosas, desviar la atención de los medios por el problema con Magdalena. Gabriel acepta, y Gloria lo acompaña.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Gabriel debe alejarse de la ciudad para llegar a un pueblo llamado Caja Seca por razones de trabajo. Lo que nunca se imagina es que Magdalena se encuentre en ese pueblo también por asuntos laborales, y el destino hace que se junten. Gloria decide contarle a Gabriel que ella ya está al tanto de la enfermedad que tiene él en los riñones. Su intención es ayudarlo en lo que necesite y que pueda confiar en ella. Sin embargo, él siente que la gente le puede llegar a tener lástima y, por eso, quiere callar. Angie y Agustín están desesperados por comunicarse con sus respectivas parejas. Ellos llaman a Gabriel y a Magdalena pero no obtienen ninguna respuesta.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Magdalena es llevada a su casa por Gabriel León. Esto les causa una situación incómoda ya que los dos están casados. Al entrar en su casa, Magdalena encuentra a su hijo Rodrigo llorando en el armario. El papá, Agustín, lo había retado y dejado solo para irse a una reunión con Angie, la esposa de Gabriel. Epicúreo sigue en su papel de homosexual frente a Valentina, para así ganarse su amistad y respeto. Por otro lado, Maikel no está conforme con la mentira, ya que Julieta cree que es verdad que ambos son pareja. Efraín le escribe un poema a Valentina, pero Ana Belén cree que es para ella. Primero se alegra y luego se deprime, al darse cuenta que no habla de ella, sino de otra mujer.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Guillermo le consulta a Marilda por una supuesta reconciliación con Cristóbal, después de haber escuchado una conversación entre él y Ana; ante la negación de Marilda, Guillermo encuentra una posibilidad para terminar de conquistar a Ana, porque entendió que, para Cristóbal, Ana sería segunda en su lista de amores. A pesar de ello, Cristóbal se convence que debe comprar el apartamento lindero al de su primo Guillermo, y accede a firmar los registros del préstamo bancario y así, consumar la compra, a pesar de que Ana decidió no mudarse al lado del hombre que le quita el sueño por las noches, y al que sólo lo ha visto dos veces en su vida,

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Cristóbal y su primo Guillermo conversan en la plaza, Cristóbal se muestra aún vengativo con Marilda y empeñado en no fallar en su nuevo matrimonio con Ana. Pablo visita a su hija Ana y le cuenta del Fantasma, mientras Ana a él, de Guillermo, su verdadero amor. Venancio vuelve de buscar a su hijo del colegio, en el ascensor se cruza con Pedro, este se pone nervioso y Venancio lo percibe. Carlota recibe a Venancio y su nieto; Venancio expresa sus celos por Lázara. Pedro lo está espiando, nervioso, con sus cámaras, así se entera de que vive en el edificio. Mientras Barranco y Ana conversan, llega su ex, María José, y comienzan a discutir fuerte

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Nancy se retira furiosa de la junta de condominio, Pedro logra que Carlos Enrique se quede hablando con Lázara en lugar de ir detrás de su mujer. Patricia deja de estudiar y se va de la casa, harta de las burlas de Carlitos. Al pasar por delante de Pedrote este la intercepta para flirtear con ella y darle celos a Purita. Nancy los ve juntos y se indigna más aún. Cristóbal reserva el salón del condominio para casarse con Ana, ante los ojos de Guillermo. Nancy se queja con Carlitos de lo sucedido en la junta con su padre, pero a Carlitos sólo le interesa enterarse de que Purita quedó sola. Pedro logra que Cristóbal ponga de padrino de bodas al mismísimo Guillermo, generando incomodidad entre él y Ana.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Pedro tiene montado en una de las habitaciones de su apartamento un sistema de espionaje a los vecinos del condominio. Con cámaras instaladas dentro de las viviendas, va manejando y observando las conversaciones y los detalles de la vida de cada uno de los habitantes del complejo. Es así que se entera de todos los pormenores, y entre ellos descubre a Cristóbal en una conversación consigo mismo en donde deja a la luz su sospecha de infidelidad entre Ana y su primo Guillermo.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Cristóbal tiene cada vez más sospechas sobre Ana y Guillermo, y los invita a un almuerzo para tratar de que ellos durante una charla confiesen involuntariamente que se conocían de antes. Ellos tratan de conversar como si nada pasara, pero es imposible ambos estan enamorados y tratan de evitar que Cristóbal se dé cuenta. La idea del almuerzo fue de Pedro que como espía a todos en el edificio, sabe lo que le pasa a cada persona que vive allí. Venancio sigue sospechando de Pedro y su relación con el hombre muerto que apareció junto al río, pero el estafador aprovechará el interrogatorio para dar vuelta el tablero y sembrar celos de Venancio hacia Lázara, la ex mujer del policía.

programme.title: Episodio 106
programme.desc: Armando totalmente borracho le va a llevar una serenata a Briggite. Ella la recibe maravillada como siempre y cuando se van los mariachis | el se arrodilla y le dice que la ama. Finita se pone a conversar sola ya que Fabián está durmiendo la borrachera y se pone a pensar que le inventa a Armando y lo único que le viene a la cabeza es decirle que tiene una enfermedad terminal. Solymar saca a bailar a Wilker que está totalmente en otro mundo. El acepta pero pensando en Yubiri.

programme.title: Episodio 107
programme.desc: Briggite les cuenta a Ana y a Finita lo de Armando. Finita se desmaya Armando y Atanasio se encuentran y comienzan hablar de Graciela y en este momento de Briggite. Bienvenida va donde Junior y le dice que acepta trabajar en su película. Junior le entrega el guión con unas palabras que hacen llorar a Bienvenida Solymar se porta como novia de Wilker y este no dice nada. Yubiri cree esto y se va para que ellos hablen. Gisela y Juan Diego están de compras y ven a Yubiri.

programme.title: Episodio 108
programme.desc: Armando bota definitivamente a Finita de su oficina y de su vida. Por más que ella quiso explicarle | el no aceptó ninguna explicación y la sacó. Briggite anda perdida como siempre. No sabe lo que está haciendo caminando por un pasillo del centro comercial. Pero se encuentra con Yubiri y aprovecha para decirle que regrese a la agencia. Fabián sigue con el ratón. Llega Palma el Productor para darle una gran noticia a Wilker y es que consiguió una presentación en Sábado Sensacional.

programme.title: Episodio 109
programme.desc: Yubiri está super feliz en su casa repartiendo regalos a su familia y todos están que brincan de la felicidad. Lolita le dice a Wilker que la gorrita se la regaló Yubiri. Llega Solymar y comienzan a hablar sobre lo de la presentación. ROKUro y Segundo conversan de los regalos hechos por Yubiri para estrenarlos con sus respectivas conquistas. En casa de Briggite están hablando ella Carolina y Dionisia de quienes se están por casar. Llega Junior para informarles que al otro día se casa.

programme.title: Episodio 110
programme.desc: Junior y los demás están recibiendo a los invitados. Llega Pastor con Ana. Todos se sorprenden pro Olegario está que ni habla. Dionisia y ROKUro se citan en una heladería. Dionisia piensa que es para decirle la verdad | que no es médico. Pero el lo que hace es darle una tarjeta con su teléfono. Dionisia está feliz y no le importa que no le diga nada. Ya van a casar a Junior y a Jésica cuando llega Briggite y Armando. Se para la boda momentáneamente. Finita va a hablar con Armando.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Angie le pide explicaciones a Magdalena sobre las fotos que vio en el periódico de ella con Gabriel. Magdalena insiste en que es un malentendido, pero Angie no le cree. Gabriel va a la prensa y se ocupa de armar un escándalo por esto, pidiendo que se retracten públicamente por el artículo, pero Ricardo no planea hacerlo, y contraatacar nuevamente. Más tarde, Gabriel vuelve a su casa, y Angie lo espera enfurecida. Agustín le pregunta a Sofía sobre Magdalena y Gabriel, pero ella no le dice nada. Luego, Magdalena regresa a su casa, y cuando Agustín llega se pone romántico, hasta que finalmente le pregunta sobre su relación con Gabriel. Efraín llama a Valentina para citarla, pero su esposa llega, y él disimula que arregla una reunión de trabajo.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Rodrigo está dispuesto a decirle a Carlos Ernesto quién asesinó a su hermano Miguel Ferrándiz a cambio de protección legal. Leonardo, que ahora sabe que es el padre de Mateo, no sabe si casarse con Rebeca es la decisión correcta. E Irene no quiere pedirle que la deje porque es él quien debe decidirlo. Tony lleva a Maribel a un restaurante de lujo para pedirle matrimonio, pero ella sufre un pequeño percance. Leo se pelea con su madre porque ella le prohíbe salir con María Lucía. Julio cuenta que Leo no es hijo de Leonardo.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Leonardo suspende la boda y Rebeca, enojada, le dice que el padre de Leo es Miguel. Rodrigo finalmente firma su confesión, en la que expone todo el plan de Rebeca. Así que Carlos Ernesto va con la policía a la casa de los Ferrándiz para arrestarla al igual que a Adolfo y Edgar. Pero las cosas se complican cuando Rebeca se fuga. Alejandra sigue sin tener noticias de lo que está pasando y Maribel la va a visitar. Virginia está feliz porque finalmente se sepa quién mató a Miguel. Julio no se toma bien la acusación que Carlos Ernesto le hace a su mamá.

programme.title: Go Astro Boy Go!
programme.desc: Mientras el Dr. Blunt realiza un experimento de telepatía con una chinchilla, que deja su mente temporalmente atrapada en el cuerpo del animal, el Equipo Astro investiga los misterios del teatro "embrujado". Suzu sube al escenario y canta. ¡Ay! Astro y Astro-Kitty piensan que su voz chillona debería ser suficiente para espantar a cualquier fantasma, pero los ruidos inquietantes continúan hasta que el Equipo Astro descubre al enamorado Derek, un ave lira capaz de reproducir cualquier sonido humano, los cuales incorpora en una canción con la esperanza de atraer a una pareja. Él y Suzu cantan a dúo y casi "echan abajo el teatro" cuando sus voces funden el cableado defectuoso de los micrófonos y provocan un incendio. El Equipo Astro apaga el fuego y salva el teatro y, para sorpresa de todos, la canción de Derek le consigue una pareja.

programme.title: Hecho en Chinatown
programme.desc: Es Goodfellas y Ip Man cuando un joven chino don nadie se propone convertirse en Don de la mafia italiana. Pero las tensiones ya son altas entre las dos culturas a medida que se mueven en el territorio del otro y un comisionado de delitos sucios juega en ambos lados. Resulta que ganarse el respeto, encontrar el amor y descubrir su identidad no es tan fácil. Tendrá que luchar para llegar a la cima.

programme.title: La Lucha de un Guerrero
programme.desc: Om es un súper comando que tiene la importante misión de devolver al Rashtra Kavach (que literalmente se traduce como guardia de seguridad del país) a buenas manos y salvar la nación. Está a punto de completar su misión cuando recibe un disparo y vuelve a la vida solo para darse cuenta de que ha perdido la memoria. Mientras tanto, Kavya Sharma se ocupa de él mientras otros funcionarios de la agencia gubernamental de élite, Murthy y Jai Rathod, están ocupados pensando cómo hacer que Om regrese a la misión. Pero no es tan sencillo como parece desde fuera. Mientras salva a su nación, Om tiene mucho más por descubrir: por ejemplo, encontrar a su padre Dev Rathod y demostrar que no era un traidor.

programme.title: THE WAWIES
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler into a new personality.

programme.sub-title: Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she and Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fills in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia's, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can effect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Goes To School

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch, and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: Chasin' The Sun
programme.desc: While releasing a defeated tarpon healthy after an epic battle is the ultimate victory, everything else is measured in heartbreak and degrees of failure. For Justin, putting Ethan on his first silver king requires patience and a tasty diversion by a local chef.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: On opening day of Missouri’s gun season, hunters from around the state seek ridges and box blinds throughout the “Show Me” state in search of mature whitetail bucks. For Nikki Boxler and the Winchester Deer Camp, it’s no different. With Winchester’s in hand, Nikki and crew play cat and mouse with several mature bucks at Indian Hill Outfitters in Pike County.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Every season, just like clockwork, mission-driven longboards gobble their way across the plains of South Dakota, the cornfields of Iowa, the timbered ridges of Michigan and the cattle ground of Kansas looking for their soulmates in one of the most celebrated hunting seasons in America…the wild turkey breeding season. Join Team Winchester as they stalk, call, flank and roost boss gobblers into range from coast to coast.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew heads to Colorado to field test Winchester’s new Supreme Long Range ammunition—engineered for hunters who demand precision at extended distances. Featuring the BC Max bullet, built with a high ballistic coefficient, heat-resistant tip, and match-grade components, this round is designed for flatter trajectories, reduced wind drift, and devastating terminal performance. - After confirming zero and studying real-world drop and wind deflection at the range, the team heads into Colorado’s rugged backcountry in pursuit of mule deer and elk. With fresh snow, steep canyons, and long shooting lanes, the terrain offers the perfect proving ground to see how the new bullet performs under pressure. - From close-range opportunities to challenging cross-canyon shots, this hunt puts the technology—and the hunters—to the test in one of the West’s toughest landscapes.

programme.title: Behind The Draw
programme.desc: Shawn & Mike were lucky enough to both draw NM Elk tags and are headed west to visit long-time friend Eddie Ortega from Hunters New Mexico. While they had both hunted there before and had a pretty good idea of what to expect, neither of them could have imagined just how crazy the hunt would go. Here is Mike's incredible hunt to end Part 2 of the week!

programme.title: Behind The Draw
programme.desc: Andy had high hopes for his Public Land archery hunt in the middle of the rut. Little did he know it would all come together right as he was about to take a lunch break!

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: Opening day in Mississippi has arrived and Slade is taking full advantage of it! With the weather not cooperating Slade and Zeb stumble into a turkey hunt they won't soon forget. Two days later, the hot streak continues with Slade connecting on another turkey on an 83 acre property he has for sale! Also, Slade gives some tips and his ideas on small acreage hunting, and how it can be just as lucrative as big tracks of land!

For veteran hunter Adam Hays, last season was unlike any other. After years of pursuing trophy whitetails, he accomplished what most hunters only dream of - taking down two record-book Boone & Crockett giants in a single season. Witness the incredible hunts that made this his most memorable year yet.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy and his son, Logan visit the beautiful country of New Zealand. From visiting Vineyards and sampling wine, to helicopter hunts for Himalayan Tahr, this episode is everything that is a hunters dream. As well as harvesting the wild game New Zealand has to offer Andy also learns about the importance of the conservation efforts that hunting has in this country from locals in which he spends time with.

programme.title: Canadian Whitetail
programme.desc: Young Beau grinds away in his home province to turn up a big mature whitetail.

programme.title: HuntStand Presents
programme.desc: The West Texas desert has a way of pulling you in. In Desert Ghost, Will Cooper heads west to Marathon, Texas, with longtime friend and mentor Cody Roberts to hunt aoudad in one of the most remote landscapes in the state. Rooted in family legacy, this film explores Cody’s deep ties to the desert, the story behind Desert Ghost Distillery, and the mystique of a western oasis near Big Bend National Park. More than a hunt, Desert Ghost dives into the role of aoudad management and its importance to desert bighorn sheep conservation efforts led by Texas Parks and Wildlife and the Wild Sheep Foundation. Sometimes, to protect what belongs here — you have to chase the ghosts. You really do have to be tough, determined, or one lucky bastard to make it out in West Texas.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: November treated Michael Hunsucker of Heartland Bowhunter right in Missouri! After battling light and variable winds for several days, Mike finally got the steady northwest breeze he needed to slip into a transition area between a destination bean field and one of the best bedding areas on the property.

programme.title: Bearded Buck
programme.desc: Join Gavin as he heads to his home state of NY to chase whitetails during the gun season.

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation
programme.desc: In the sparsely populated country of Namibia, in southern Africa, Dan Cabela visits conservationist Robin Hurt to see how private land ownership and hunting have restored the landscape to a thriving wildlife area.

programme.title: Realtree Road Trips
programme.desc: Evan Williams from Hoyt and Tyler Jordan hit the mountains of Colorado in search of rutting Mule Deer with their bows, but the hunt takes an unexpected turn.

programme.title: Realtree Road Trips
programme.desc: On his third trip of the season to Kansas, Tyler Jordan finally connects on a big flyer buck with his Hoyt RX-10 in hand. Everything comes together in a heart-pounding moment that bow hunters dream about.

programme.title: Realtree Road Trips
programme.desc: Tyler Jordan hunts his farm in Georgia and tags out on a beautiful 10 pointer using the Franchi .308.

programme.title: Realtree Road Trips
programme.desc: After taking 2 great bucks in Nebraska, the Road Trips crew came back home to Georgia with Tyler and Rigsby taking bucks on back to back sits! Dash makes 3 Georgia bucks in 3 sits!

programme.title: Realtree Road Trips
programme.desc: Dink Watson and Sheldon Lye of New Zealand Hunting Adventures host Tyler Jordan on an unforgettable turkey hunt in New Zealand. This hunt isn’t just about incredible action, it’s about conservation, perception, and the future of the wild turkey.

programme.title: Realtree Roadtrips
programme.desc: Riley Green heads down to South Louisiana to finish out duck and deer season. The first morning duck hunt was absolutely epic with a 7 man limit at 7:35 am. Day 3 in the deer blind proved to be all Riley needed to close out his deer season with a big, wide 10 point!

programme.title: The Raven Project
programme.desc: The boys are still at the Raven in Missouri trying to finish planting 50 acres of Big Tine food plots in 5 days. Then Randy heads to the Powder River in Montana and tries to knock down his first buck of the 2025 season.

programme.title: The Raven Project
programme.desc: Randy and the crew are finishing up the last of the food plots on the Raven and then the Tikka rifles come out as we fast forward to rifle camp at the Raven. Nate is able to catch up with a dandy of a buck and Randy's dad Travis also known as “Big Haus” is able to catch up with a fine Missouri buck of his own.

programme.title: The Raven Project

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Water quality is everything—and the Star brite - SeaSafe team is back at it for the second year in a row! Led by Cory Redwine, Conservation Director of Project SeaSafe, this is the 4th Annual Clean Water Collective and it’s bigger than ever. This time, we’re in Grant, Florida, where 4 million clams are being released into the Indian River Lagoon, paired with the planting of thousands of mangroves, oyster work by CCA and trash clean ups to help restore one of Florida’s most critical ecosystems. But it’s not just about hard work—it’s about connection. With local captains, fishing legends, and the Local Knowledge crew on hand, we hit the water to show why this place is worth fighting for. From clam drops by drone, to in-water mangrove planting, to monster snook catches, this is hands-on conservation at its best. This two-part series kicks off with action, heart, and the kind of hope only a healthy waterway can bring. Don’t miss Part 1—where conservation meets community and everyone gets their hands wet.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: As part of this year's Star brite Sea Safe event, we hit the water to experience some of the incredible fishing the Indian River Lagoon has to offer. The bite wasn't easy, but that didn't stop Rush from smashing his personal best - not once, but twice - in one unforgettable day on the water. Don't miss this action-packed episode of the Sea Safe adventure from beautiful Sebastian, Florida!

The rigs are holding GIANT mangrove snapper, bruiser cobia, and hard-fighting jacks… but getting them to the boat is a whole different story. Fishing heavy structure means short strikes, busted hooks, shredded leaders, and fish that know exactly where to run. Around these rigs it’s not just fishing — it’s full-blown combat. If you want to land one of these beasts, you better bring extra hooks, heavy tackle, and a whole lot of patience. Easier said than done. Venice, Louisiana continues to prove why it’s one of the most action-packed fisheries in the country.

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Shotgun sports are experiencing unprecedented growth, with competitions across the country gaining popularity as enthusiasts vie to be the best shooters in the world. Every summer, the Amateur Trapshooting Association hosts The Grand American in Sparta, Illinois. This year marks the 125th Anniversary for the largest trap shooting competition in the world. We’ll talk with the people who make this tournament run behind the scenes and explore what makes this tournament such a special event. We’ll also look at the rich history of The Grand. On-site we’ll chat with the curator of the Trapshooting Hall of Fame and look at some of the incredible historical pieces on display in the museum. Additionally, we’ll learn about White Flyer and how the clay manufacturer has made important innovations for the shotgun sports.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: No-one creates eco-disasters on quite the scale of the former Soviet Union. In Uzbekistan, the Aral Sea, once one of the largest freshwater lakes in the world, has seen its waters diverted, so that it has shrunk to 1/6 its previous size. In Crimea, a mountain has been carved into a james bondian submarine base. In northern Ukraine, the Chernobyl nuclear site has been reduced to a radioactive wasteland.

programme.title: Angry Planet

programme.title: Angry Planet

programme.title: Extreme Weather Countdown
programme.desc: What's windy, wild, and wet all over? The weather, of course! And over the next half hour, we're bringing you some of the craziest moments ever captured on camera! From the hailstorms that destory windows to the breathtaking tornados, we've got it all, right here on Extreme Weather Countdown.

programme.title: Extreme Weather Countdown

programme.title: Extreme Weather Countdown

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Host/adventurer George Kourounis explores the American Southwest during the Desert Monsoon. He ups the danger factor by traveling with wild atheist shock-jock R.J. Evans to track massive lightning storms which can produce bolts of up to one hundred million volts. The pair come close - too close - to dangerous electrical clouds swirling over Tucson, Sedona and Monument Valley.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: With summer wildfires overpowering the Yukon forests, host/adventurer George Kourounis follows the fabled route of the Klondike Gold Rush sourdoughs through the bawdy town of Skagway, Alaska, paddling the white water rivers and the White Horse Rapids into the Yukon. He travels on mountain bike, steam train and Cessna to experience the huge fires and meet the northern fire crews battling the blazes.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: George tracks twisters through the Tornado Alley and descends into the Erte Ale Volcano.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: George investigates the wild side of water in dangerous class 5 river rapids.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Mount Washington, New Hampshire has the dubious title of being home to the world’s worst weather. The highest wind ever recorded on the planet – 231 miles per hour – was recorded at its mountaintop observatory. To prepare for a mid-winter assault on the summit, Angry Planet host George Kourounis becomes a “human popsicle”, encased in ice in at the National Resarch Council’s high speed wind tunnel. Then he and his sidekick Mark Robinson climb to the top of the mountain in mid-January and brave their way into a summit blizzard.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Dominica, the most volcanic and mountainous island in the Caribbean, is home to the Boiling Lake, a large waterfall-fed lake of furiously boiling water. Adventurer George Kourounis becomes the first person ever to traverse across the lake on a rope, risking his life to take water samples and shoot video from a place no human has ever been. He then dives to the ocean floor off the coast of the island to explore vents where the superheated water bubbles into the ocean.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: George experiences the most extreme climates in North America. First he visits the hottest place on the continent – Death Valley, then the coldest – Snag, Yukon.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: In the porous limestone of Canada’s West Coast, great forces are at work under the ground, building and eroding the underground into fantastic shapes. In this episode we’ll witness George’s explorations of these massive underground cave systems.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Stormchasing developed in Australia in the same period – the 1990s – as it developed in the American Midwest. In the first week of December – the height of storm season in Australia, we plan to travel with Jimmy Deguara, the most experienced of Australian stormchasers.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Italy is one of the very few nations in the world that regularly gets three major extreme natural phenomena – volcanos, flooding, and avalanches. Eastern flanks of the volcano to slip by up to two metres, and many houses on the flanks of the volcano experienced structural damage. The eruption also completely destroyed the Rifugio Sapienza, on the southern flank of the volcano. The Rifugio was the site of a cable car station which had previously been destroyed in the 1983 eruption; both have now been rebuilt. The most recent eruption was in November 2006.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: It is time for “Angry Planet” to do a serious desert episode. What better place to do it than this fabled city in the middle of the mighty Sahara Desert.This almost mythical place really does exist. And it really is still possible to travel there by camel caravan, riding the infamous “Ships of the Desert”. Extreme heat, dehydration, possible sand storms, frigid night temperatures and desert predators are our potential companions for the trip.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Geoorge explores Java at the heart of the Ring of Fire.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: “Angry Planet” is there as 3 storms make landfall as hurricanes in the US.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: No-one creates eco-disasters on quite the scale of the former Soviet Union. In Uzbekistan, the Aral Sea, once one of the largest freshwater lakes in the world, has seen its waters diverted, so that it has shrunk to 1/6 its previous size. In Crimea, a mountain has been carved into a james bondian submarine base. In northern Ukraine, the Chernobyl nuclear site has been reduced to a radioactive wasteland.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: George returns to the “Fin Del Mundo” at the southern tip of Argentina, this time to sail on a Russian icebreaker to Antarctica. After braving the stormy Drake passage, he explores volcanic Deception Island, camps out in the Antarctic snow, and paddles a kayak through icebergs calved off the melting glaciers.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Filming the volcanoes, mudpools and geysers in the geothermic wonderland of New Zealand’s north island, we learn that a new island is being created by an undersea volcano 1000 miles north in Tonga. Determined to be among the first to see this “newest land on earth”, we head for the remote island by plane and boat, after various nautical mishaps, George ends up, bedraggled and clad in nothing but underwear and a lifejacket, honored to be one of the very first to explore this brand new island.
